rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone stubbornly refuses to change their mind or follow others.

example.english: He is so headstrong that he refuses to change the plan no matter how much everyone advises him.
example.traditional: 佢固執到咁，大家點勸佢都唔肯改個計劃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gu3 zap1 dou3 gam3 daai6 gaa1 dim2 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 m4 hang2 goi2 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when the person insists on doing what they want, especially in a childish or teenage way.

example.english: The child is very headstrong and cries in the shop if we do not buy it for him.
example.traditional: 個細路好任性，唔買畀佢就喺舖頭度喊。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 hou2 jam6 sing3 m4 maai5 bei2 keoi5 zau6 hai2 pou3 tau2 dou6 haam3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone goes their own way and disregards what other people expect.

example.english: They have always been headstrong and never care what other people think.
example.traditional: 佢一向我行我素，完全唔理人哋點睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 ngo5 hang4 ngo5 sou3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6 dim2 tai2
